seo.title: Homeless and housing-crisis help in Kingston - No Home Help
seo.description: Current Kingston contacts for emergency shelter access, day services, food, health care, benefits, jobs and other help for people without stable housing.

page.heading: Homeless and housing-crisis help in Kingston
page.urgent: For immediate danger or a life-threatening medical emergency, call the local emergency number shown below.
page.notice: Shelters and services can be full, change hours or require an assessment or referral. Call before travelling whenever possible. No listing guarantees a bed, housing, treatment, benefits or a job.
page.intro: If one shelter is full, try the other local services and the referral lines below. Ask about day centres, outreach, food, hygiene, health care and the next safe option; do not rely on a single address.

entries.title: 119 police / 110 fire and ambulance
entries.description: Call for immediate danger, serious injury, fire or violence. State the exact location first.

entries.title: Marie Atkins Night Shelter
entries.description: Municipal night shelter with limited capacity. Call before travelling and ask for another Kingston option if full.
entries.how_to_access: Call or check the official page before travelling. Capacity is not guaranteed; ask about eligibility, documents, referral rules and an alternative if the service is full.

entries.title: Desmond McKenzie Transitional Centre
entries.description: Transitional facility for people experiencing homelessness. Admission and beds depend on assessment and capacity; phone first.
entries.how_to_access: Call or check the official page before travelling. Capacity is not guaranteed; ask about eligibility, documents, referral rules and an alternative if the service is full.

entries.title: PATH — social assistance
entries.description: Official information on Jamaica's Programme of Advancement Through Health and Education. Application does not guarantee immediate payment.

entries.title: Labour Market Information System
entries.description: Government job search, career information and employment services.

entries.title: Bureau of Gender Affairs
entries.description: Government contacts and referrals for gender-based violence; use emergency services for immediate danger.

entries.title: Government homelessness services overview
entries.description: Official explanation of drop-in, night-shelter and transitional services. Use the facility list and confirm each contact before travelling.
